{{Quote|Sithfire! Agamar, then Vinsoth, and now Borosk&mdash;all lost!|Emperor Roan Fel|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
In [[138 ABY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] '''fell''' to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]] had recently begun a renewed military push against his enemies after [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|reclaiming]] his usurped Imperial throne, and Vinsoth&mdash;within the borders of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]] but positioned close to Krayt's own territory&mdash;was one of his targets. The world was conquered by Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]]&ndash;Imperials, and Fel grew increasingly frustrated with his enemy's military might.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Once, I thought to bring peace and order to the galaxy through the existing governments&mdash;to align the worlds to the rule of the One Sith. That cannot work. The galaxy must experience the pain of death and the rapture of rebirth as I have. I will bring chaos. It is time for ''war''.|Darth Krayt, after regaining control of his Galactic Empire|<ref name="Legacy War 1" />}}
In [[138 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], deposed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] returned to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to reclaim his mantle as ruler of both the [[One Sith]] and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. Supported by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warriors loyal to him and an [[Army/Legends|army]] of specialized [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]], he led an [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|assault]] on Coruscant's [[Temple of the Sith]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] his usurper, [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]]. His mission complete, Krayt vowed to wage renewed war against all who opposed his Empire.<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

==The fall==
{{Quote|However, your latest campaigns have taught the galaxy the meaning of fear and the recklessness of incurring your wrath, my Lord.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]], reporting to Darth Krayt after the fall of Vinsoth|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
[[Imperial Military/Legends|Forces]] of the Empire launched several military campaigns against Krayt's enemies, including a strike at the planet [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]]. The world was under the control of former [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]]<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> but lay within the outer regions of his territory.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Fel's forces were defeated in the battle, and Vinsoth was claimed by the Sith&ndash;Imperials.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We're stretched thinner and thinner, but the Sith keep coming no matter the price they pay! It's as if Krayt thinks he has unlimited troops!|Roan Fel, lamenting the falls of Vinsoth and several other planets|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
The fall of Vinsoth was one of several battles that caused factions across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to bow to the might of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] Krayt. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Fel rued the losses of lives and resources that his Empire incurred at Vinsoth and in other theaters, as well as the resulting thin spread of his forces. When the Sith [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Darth Maladi]], held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] on Fel's [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], offered to create him a [[Omega Red|toxin]] that could [[Speciecide|kill]] all the life on a planet, Fel considered using the weapon against the seemingly-unstoppable Sith.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinsoth's fall to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt's Empire was mentioned in the [[Legacy — War 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> on [[January 26]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54442/star_wars_legacy_-_war_2010_2|text=Star Wars: Legacy - War (2010) #2}}</ref>
